description: Fetch any ABS dataflow with an SDMX key from abs_describe_dataflow. Keep keys narrow - an empty key on a big dataflow returns thousands of series. Use last_n to just get the latest values.

end.description: Latest period, YYYY-MM. Omit for up to the latest release.

key.description: SDMX key, e.g. '3.10001.10.50.M'. Use 'all' only with last_n on small dataflows.

last_n.description: Only the last N observations per series.

start.description: Earliest period, YYYY-MM (e.g. 2022-01). Omit for the full history.

name: abs_get_data
title: Get ABS data
